title: 第3章 见面第4章 逆天珠
content_zh:
随着最后最后一滴精血汇入到命门穴中，整个穴位充满爆炸性的力量，血液奔腾如海。
至此，全身一百零八个穴位已经锻炼了三十二个！
全身经络比普通人强大不知多少倍。
所以实力更是超出十倍不止！
“这个功法果然强大！
就是不知道是什么品阶？难道是玄阶功法？不然不可能短短两年就让我突破到先天层次。”
萧天默默想道。
傲武大陆，功法大致分为：凡阶、玄阶、地阶、天阶。
至于天阶之上萧天没有听说过。
武器也是大致分类。
萧天活动活动筋骨，随意的挥出一拳，都带起破空之声！
甚是厉害。
萧天脸上充满自信的笑容。
“糟糕，忘记时间了，这一个突破就花了一天一夜，还真是修炼无岁月。
也难怪哪些大佬一次闭关就是几百年甚至更长。
太不可思议了。
我得要过去醉仙楼了。”
随后把重剑背在身上走出房门。
萧家之人看到萧天背着重剑已经是见怪不怪了。
大家都认为萧天是普通的，可能就是力气稍微大点的武夫。

背重剑，是装十三的。
对于身边的闲言碎语，萧天已经不去理会。
现在距离跟叶净心见面的时间还有一个时辰，但从萧家到醉仙楼还是有一段距离。
走路，在不施展身法时，还是需要一两刻钟的。
城里绝大数时间是禁止坐骑在街上奔跑的。
萧天在街上走着，南陵城只是流云国的一个小城。
像流云国这样的低等小国在南洲就不下数百个。
南洲还有一百个中等国，三十个上等国，还有五大帝国。
帝国又依附宗门，每个国家背后都有宗门的支持，所以关系盘根错节，非常庞大而复杂。
所以，南陵城就像尘埃一样渺小。
不过再小的城池，这里也生活着几十万的人口！
城中设施和商品也是应有尽有，只是相对低级。
走了一刻钟，到了醉仙楼前。
只看醉仙楼高十几丈，分七层，长十丈，宽也有八丈，外面雕龙画凤，栩栩如生，屋面琉璃瓦覆盖，熠熠生辉，好是大气！
走进醉仙楼，大厅里人声鼎沸，有人讨论着花楼姑娘，有的讨论着三个月后的宗门选拔。
最让萧天意外的是，还有人谈论两年前正月十五晚上的事！
只听到说“帝国的人在找两年前出现的东西，好像是大宝贝，嘿嘿…”
“要是让我得到，肯定能飞黄腾达”
content_en:
As the last drop of essence and blood flowed into the Mingmen acupoint, the entire acupoint was filled with explosive power, and the blood surged like a sea.
So far, thirty-two of the one hundred and eight acupuncture points on the body have been exercised!
The meridians throughout the body are countless times more powerful than ordinary people.
Therefore, the strength is more than ten times greater!
“This technique is really powerful!
I just don’t know what grade it is? Could it be Xuanjie Kung Fu? Otherwise, it would be impossible for me to break through to the innate level in just two years. "
Xiao Tian thought silently.
In Aowu Continent, the skills are roughly divided into: ordinary level, mysterious level, earth level, and heaven level.
As for Xiao Tian who is above the heaven level, he has never heard of it.
Weapons are also roughly classified.
Xiao Tian moved his muscles and bones, and threw out a punch at will, which made a sound of breaking through the air!
Very powerful.
Xiao Tian had a confident smile on his face.
"Oops, I lost track of time. This breakthrough only took a day and a night. It really takes no time to practice.
It's no wonder that some big guys stay in seclusion for hundreds of years or even longer at a time.
It's incredible.
I have to go to Zuixian Tower. "
Then he put the heavy sword on his back and walked out of the room.
The people of the Xiao family were not surprised to see Xiao Tian carrying a heavy sword.
Everyone thinks that Xiao Tian is ordinary, maybe a martial artist with a little more strength.
Carrying a heavy sword on one's back is to show off one's thirteenth.
Xiao Tian no longer paid attention to the gossip around him.
There is still an hour before the meeting with Ye Jingxin, but there is still a distance from Xiao's house to Zuixian Tower.
Walking, when you are not using your body skills, still takes a quarter of an hour or two.
Most of the time in the city, horses are prohibited from running on the streets.
Xiao Tian was walking on the street. Nanling City was just a small city in Liuyun Kingdom.
There are hundreds of low-level small countries like Liuyun Country in Southern Continent.
There are also one hundred medium-sized countries, thirty superior countries, and five great empires in Nanzhou.
The empire is also dependent on the sect, and every country has the support of the sect, so the relationship is intricate, very large and complex.
Therefore, Nanling City is as small as dust.
No matter how small the city is, there are still hundreds of thousands of people living here!
The facilities and products in the city are all available, but they are relatively low-level.
After walking for a quarter of an hour, we arrived in front of Zuixian Tower.
Just look at the Zuixian Tower, which is more than ten feet high, divided into seven floors, ten feet long and eight feet wide. The outside is carved with dragons and phoenixes, lifelike, and the roof is covered with glazed tiles, shining brightly. It is so grand!
Walking into Zuixian Tower, the hall was full of people. Some were discussing the girl from Hualou, and some were discussing the selection of the sect in three months.
What surprised Xiao Tian the most was that there were still people talking about what happened on the fifteenth night of the first lunar month two years ago!
I only heard someone say, "The people in the empire are looking for something that appeared two years ago. It seems to be a big treasure, hehe..."
"If you let me get it, I will definitely become famous."
